key_idea: The rest of the program is unchanged, so normalise by it: foo's time relative to the rest is x/(100-x) before and y/(100-y) after.
sketch: Answer = [x/(100-x)] / [y/(100-y)] = x(100-y) / (y(100-x)). O(1), printed as a double. The only trap is computing the naive x/y, which ignores that the total running time also shrank.
